scope: v0.26.5 RC9 attempt 40 supersedes RC8 attempt 39 after user testing proved the shipped model rendering remained too dark/gray and the Recomps native picker did not expose executable files. The exact user GOG.glb is known to render correctly purple/blue in Open3D Viewer, so RC9 fixes the Huymaier D3D11 renderer rather than replacing or modifying the user's model. The shelf/runtime must use the shared HUYMAIER_D3D11_SHELF_SHADER_V4_COLOR_MANAGED_UI_PBR HLSL from HuymaierD3D11ShelfAsset.h: decode glTF base-color/emissive sRGB into linear light, preserve MR/normal/AO as linear data, use camera-facing key/fill lighting, avoid metallic diffuse crushing, use base-color-tinted metallic F0/environment specular instead of whitening materials, and encode final linear RGB back to sRGB/display space before writing the WPF/D3DImage UNORM target. Native x64 runtime compilation and the WARP regression must compile that exact shared production HLSL, not a simplified test shader. The production-HLSL pixel regression must require visible, colorful and bright-colorful pixels so a technically nonblack but visibly charcoal model cannot pass again; generated GOG must still remain purple through GLB -> HC3D v3 -> exact-production-HLSL WARP pixels. Recomps remains a direct persistent manual EXE library. Its native PickExecutable/RecompGame browser must retain drives/folders, list normal and hidden/system .exe files in the selected directory, and exclude .lnk, .url, .txt and all other non-EXE files. Preserve the shared HC3D v3/D3D11 full-screen viewer with HC_GPU_SetShelfItemView/SetItemView and shared brightness. Preserve canonical visible labels without changing emulator routing identities, especially 32X -> Sega 32X plus full Sega/Nintendo/PlayStation and provider branding labels. Preserve V7 native D3D11 shelves, persistent GPU cache, zero bundled GLBs, unified native cursor, streaming, GameCube, downloads/history, provider concurrency, artwork persistence, external foreground apps, installer rollback/tamper behavior, Steam ownership and all frozen PS1/PS2/PS3/emulator-console behavior.
